IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.NoComponentsToDam: No Components (Roles) to choose (dealing 2 Hull damage)!

IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.NotInRammingLine: Target not in a straight line!

IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Repair:
Challenging (+0) Tech (Voidship).
Cost 1 Action Point.
You can choose to fix all Damaged Components (Roles), one Damaged Weapon or regain 5 Shields in one location.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Rally:
Challenging (+0) Rapport (Rallying).
Cost 1 Action Point.
You can choose to remove all stacks of OnFire!, remove 1 Fatigue or remove 1 Critical Damage value 11 or lower.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Scan:
Challenging (+0) Awareness (Void) + Detection Rating.
Cost 1 Action Point.
You can add +1 SL bonus to one ship's weapons test.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Boarding:
Opposed Challenging (+0) Presence (Boarding) versus Target’s Rapport (Rallying) + Turret Rating.
Cost 2 Action Points, range 2 Hexes.
You can deal 1 stack of OnFire!, damage one Component (Role), damage one Weapon, deal 1 Morale Damage or deal SL in Hull Damage. [This action doesn't work correctly without a target].
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ReloadSpecial:
Challenging (+0) Rapport (Rallying).
Cost 2 Action Points.
This is used mainly for weapons that do not have dedicated reload actions.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.RestartShields:
Routine (+20) Logic (Complex).
Cost 2 Action Points.
You can refresh Shields on one sides (to full), but receive a -1 SL penalty to Shooting tests. Difficulty rises each time used in combat. [Can be changed in Modifiers tab]
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Seek:
Opposed Challenging (+0) Awareness (Void) + Detection Rating versus Target’s Piloting (Major Voidship) - Size.
Cost 1 Action Point.
You can try to find targets that are Silent Running.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.EvasiveManeuvers:
Challenging (+0) Piloting (Major Voidship).
Can only be used at the start of the turn, taking half of Movement Points. This grants Disadvantage to enemies trying to hit the voidship (with additional -SL per +SL on the test), but a Disadvantage on all actions by the voidship.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Ramming:
Opposed Challenging (+0) Piloting (Major Voidship).
Cost 4 Movement Points and the target must be in the first 4 hexes in fore. This will deal damage to the target and some to the voidship, as well as move the voidship next to it.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.SilentRunning:
Opposed Challenging (+0) Piloting (Major Voidship) - Size versus Target’s Awareness (Void) + Detection Rating.
If no enemy detects you, you gain Advantage on tests against them. Enemies will auto detect you if you will be near them.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.RepairMinion:
Minion Ships do not make tests.
With Repair they either repair 1 Damaged Weapon or remove all stacks of OnFire!
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ScanMinion:
Minion Ships do not make tests.
With Scan they nominate one target, all attacks gain +1 SL against them.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.OnFire: OnFire stacks that deal Hull Damage on start of each turn.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Fatigue: When Morale Damage is dealt, it becomes Fatigue. The maximum Fatigue is Crew Rating Bonus (unmodified by Fatigue).
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.CrewRiots: When Fatigue goes so high, it lowers Crew Rating to 0, the voidship is defeated as the crew riots.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Fatigued: When Fatigue goes over its maximum, it will lower Crew Rating by 10, stacks. If it falls to 0, riots will commence.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Shields: Shields are the first thing hit, when typical attacks are made. Shields normally never go beyond maximum.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ShieldsAverage: Instead of using locations, use this Average for the whole ship.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ArmourAverage: Instead of using locations, use this Average for the whole ship.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.WeaponLocations:
Weapons mounted will have specific Arcs. Remember that some weapons can't be installed in some locations.
Prow and Aft weapons have 30 Degree Arcs (60 for Wide Arcs), while Port and Starboard 90 Degrees. Dorsal will have 270 Degrees, while Keel is 360 Degrees.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ShipPoints: Ship's total number of Ship Points based on any Ship Parts the ship has (hull, components, etc).
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.SpaceUsed: Ship's current used and maximum space for Supplemental Components.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.EssentialComponents: Core Components. They will be swapped if newer are dragged.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.SupplementalComponents: Combat Supplemental Components. Typically each takes 1 point of Space.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.NonCombatSupplementalComponents: Non-Combat Supplemental Components. Typically each takes 0.5 point of Space.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ShipType: Type of the Ship. Only Minion has changes. You can change this in Modifiers tab.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.FatePoints: If a Ship is Fated, it has Fate Points. These can be used for rolls (Advantage, reroll, etc).
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.MovementPoints:
Movement Points available to the ship. Left click to add, right click to remove.
Movement Points are typically based on the ship's Speed Rating.
These are reset at the start of the turn. Remember, the ship must use at least half each turn!
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.MovementPreview:
Click to see a preview of movement available to the ship. It will disappear after 2 seconds.
Preview doesn't take into account Zones that modify movement.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.MovementMove:
Click to start movement, then click on the highlighted hexes to move the ship. Movement Points will deducted automatically, then the ship will move.
Preview doesn't take into account Zones that modify movement.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.MovementReset: Reset Movement Points (as well as turn rating that is taken into account for movement preview).
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ActionPoints:
Action Points available to the ship. Left click to add, right click to remove.
Action Points typically are based on Crew Rating Bonus.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.CrewRating: Crew Rating. Crew Rating Bonus is Crew Rating/10. Crew Rating can be modified if too much Fatigue (but Fatigue doesn't affect the Bonus).
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Size:
Size doesn't affect the ship, but might give penalties or bonuses to certain maneuvers.
Some weapons can only be installed on ships of Size 4 or higher.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.SpeedRating: Speed of the ship. This is the base of Movement Points.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.TurnRating: Hexes required before the ship may turn.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.EvasionRating: Evasion Rating is mainly used passively as a penalty to shooting the ship.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.DetectionRating: Detection Rating is used mainly for actions where augurs are important like detecting enemy ships or shooting.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.TurretRating: Turret Rating helps against Boarding Actions and defend against Torpedo Salvos and Squadrons.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Supplemental: How many Supplemental Components can the ship have (used as Space in Components tab).
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.WeaponsConfiguration: What weapon slots are available for the ship.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.CrewExperience:
Crew Experience.
You can spend 100xp to buy Crew Traits or multiple of 500xp to increase Crew Rating.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.FixDefyDeath: Resets Defy Death countdown and usage, doesn't reactivate Roles.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.FixBlocks: Used to fix sheet blocks for previews.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ResetActionCost: Used to reset 'turn by turn' stacking Action cost.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.RoleActive: When a role is Inactive, it can't be used.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.StatusDamaged: Component is damaged and less effective. Roles become inactive, Weapons gain Disadvantage to tests.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.Cooldown: Rounds remaining until the action is ready. Left click to increase, right click to decrease.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.AssignedRole: You can assign a Crew Member to the Role. This doesn't automate Skill or Specializations, these must be added manually.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ShootingTest:
Challenging (+0) Ranged (Voidship) + Detection Rating - Target's Evasion Rating.
If attack is made at half Range, it gains Advantage.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.CheckRangeFull: Shows a preview of the Weapon's Range Arc. It will disappear after 2 seconds.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.CheckRangeHalf: Shows a preview of half the Weapon's Range Arc. It will disappear after 2 seconds.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.NovaCannonTest:
Hard (-20) Ranged (Voidship) + Detection Rating.
Choose a target hex at least 6 Hexes from the Fore. If failed, the blast might explode near the shooter.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ReloadNovaCannon:
Challenging (+0) Rapport (Rallying).
Cost 2 Action Points.
Nova Cannons require reloading afte shooting. On success, you can shoot the weapon in the next turn.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.LaunchSquadron: Launch a Squadron. This will mark the weapon as requiring Reload. No token will appear.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.DogfightTest:
Opposed Challenging (+0) Navigation (Void) + Squadron Rating
You need to target the enemy Voidship, not other tokens.
On success, you can defeat enemy Squadrons.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.EscortVoidship: Target a voidship the Fighter Squadron will escort. This will give them an effect, increasing Turret Rating by 10.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.BomberRunTest:
Opposed Challenging (+0) Navigation (Void) + Squadron Rating versus Target's Awareness (Void) + Turret Rating.
You need to target the enemy Voidship, not other tokens.
On success, the Squadron will hit the target.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.AssaultBoardingTest:
Opposed Challenging (+0) Presence (Boarding) + Squadron Rating versus Target’s Rapport (Rallying) + half of Turret Rating.
Cost 2 Action Points.
You need to target the enemy Voidship, not other tokens.
On success, the typical Boarding message will be created.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ReloadSquadrons:
Challenging (+0) Rapport (Rallying).
Cost 2 Action Points.
On success, you can send a Squadron next turn.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.LaunchTorpedoSalvo: Launch a Torpedo Salvo. This will mark the weapon as requiring Reload. No token will appear.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.TorpedoSalvoTest:
Opposed Challenging (+0) Navigation (Void) + Torpedo Rating versus Target's Awareness (Void) + Turret Rating.
You need to target the enemy Voidship, not other tokens.
On success, the torpedo Salvo will hit the target. A Torpedo Salvo will be used from the weapon.
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Tooltip.ReloadTorpedoes:
Challenging (+0) Rapport (Rallying).
Cost 2 Action Points.
On success, you can send a Torpedo Salvo next turn.

IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Settings.Name: Void Combat Rules
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Settings.Label: Configure
IMPMAL_RTIM.VoidCombat.Settings.Hint: Optional rules and changes to void combat rules.

RandomDamage.Label: Random Damage on Components/Weapons
RandomDamage.Hint: Unless specified, always random damage Component or Weapon. Otherwise, you will be given an option - only GM can do this.

TokenDragMove.Label: Drag Move in Combat Costs
TokenDragMove.Hint: Normally, you can use the movement from the ship, but you can still drag the token. If set to true, Movement Points will be reduced (or movement stopped), when dragging a token.

EndCombat.Label: Compute End Combat
EndCombat.Hint: At end of combat, the sheet will reset Movement Points, Action Points, Role cooldowns, etc

AutomateMovementPoints.Label: Automate Movement Points
AutomateMovementPoints.Hint: When moving Token (in Combat) be it from dragging (can be changed in settings) or move button, the sheet's Movement Points will decrease.

UnrestrictedMovement.Label: Unrestricted Movement
UnrestrictedMovement.Hint: Allow Movement if no Movement Points (in Combat). Otherwise token will not move if no Movement Points.

AllowNoPoints.Label: Allow No Points
AllowNoPoints.Hint: Actions and Maneuvers can be taken when no points available. Otherwise test dialog will not show up.

AllowOnCooldown.Label: Allow on Cooldown
AllowOnCooldown.Hint: Role Actions are allowed when on Cooldown. Otherwise test dialog will not show up. Cooldown reset still happens.

AllowOutsideRange.Label: Allow Outside Range
AllowOutsideRange.Hint: Allow using weapons and boarding when target is outside of stated range. Otherwise test dialog will not show up.

AllowDeactivatedComponents.Label: Allow Deactivated
AllowDeactivatedComponents.Hint: Allow to make tests with Deactivated Components (Roles, Weapons). Otherwise test dialog will not show up.

MovementSound.Label: Movement Sound
MovementSound.Hint: Path to a movement sound, used when token is moving by button.
